response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive experience in software development across multiple domains, including embedded systems and C programming, but his resume does not demonstrate direct experience with security features for embedded networking, Linux kernel modifications, or network switch technologies. His proficiency in Japanese is also unverified, which is a critical requirement for the role.
strengths: Strong C programming experience with embedded systems (e.g., National Instruments, NI LabWindows/CVI)
Proven ability to work on diverse projects (web, mobile, embedded) with a focus on testable, high-quality code
Experience with low-latency applications and performance optimization (e.g., DLang at Dunnhumby)
concerns: No explicit experience with security features (e.g., MACsec, IEEE 802.1X, tamper detection) or networking switch technologies
No mention of Linux kernel source-code modification or embedded device security practices
Japanese language proficiency is not indicated, which is a mandatory requirement
